source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In a study of 17 young adults with NF1, about 50% of those with scoliosis diagnosed before adulthood had progression of curvature with significant back pain, and 18% had developed a new mild scoliosis.
